## Problem

Describe the user problem.

## Change

Describe the behavior change and affected hosts.

## Privacy and safety

State whether storage, permissions, guard behavior, or data handling changed.

## Evidence

List the checks and fixture results.

## Limits

State what this change does not prove or support.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests were written before the change and cover it.
- [ ] `pre-commit run --all-files` passes.
- [ ] The six checks in `AGENTS.md` pass locally.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` and affected docs are updated when behavior changes.
- [ ] No prompts, code, command output, credentials, or personal data are
      stored by the change or included in fixtures.
- [ ] The title and every commit message are Conventional Commits.
